text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, following up on the 'Osaka Hai' with a run like this!
Dream Journey's consistency is just outstanding!!"

text_block_list.name: Journey Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, that was the best~!
I really want them to do their best in the Takarazuka Kinen~!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe it's because Dream Journey is here.
It brought back memories.
Of Mejiro McQueen's Tenno Sho (Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: Even after Mejiro Bright's era, they've kept such a dominant presence on the racing scene. As expected of the Mejiro family—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady McQueen.
I am so very happy~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That the hoofprints we left behind...
continue onward in so many different forms like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes... Truly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Ms. Journey.
You have already proven yourself more than enough.
Therefore――"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please forge ahead to your heart's content.
...On a "journey" that is truly, entirely your own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after the Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"—The Takarazuka Kinen.
While countless legendary races have taken place there...—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Out of all the races Big Sis ran,
there's one I'd like to look back on right now."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: This is the race that Meisho Doto won.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...At the time, boasting overwhelming strength
and achieving the magnificent feat of 7 GⅠ victories,
he was the 'End-of-Century Overlord,' T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Against such an Overlord,
Meisho Doto was the one who had finished second five times in GⅠ races...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...That 'Takarazuka Kinen' was a race where
Opera O-san's unprecedented 8th GⅠ victory was on the line, and—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That was the race where Doto-san defeated Opera O-san for the first time and claimed victory.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To me, that race felt like
the herald of the end of an era.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...The Grand Prix is a stage where Umamusume
gather to carry the dreams of race fans of their era.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Inevitability...
Even history converges there—
choice_data_list: That's why "storms" brew so easily, too.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That's right.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Up until now, I found joy
in seeking out the 'storm'
in places like that."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "However, right now... I have found a different kind of joy there."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...You've grown remarkably sharp, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I will answer the hopes of everyone who entrusted their dreams to me and win the 'Takarazuka Kinen' without fail.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Then, what kind of outcome will that lead to?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's as if the one chasing the storm
becomes the storm itself—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —In that moment, I undoubtedly saw it. And heard it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thunderous applause and roaring cheers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The venue is enveloped in voices singing her praises.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the center of it all is the Dream Journeyer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I earnestly wish that it would happenâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The pounding in my chest.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...At this rate, rather than a travel tale,
it might be more like a fairy tale."
choice_data_list: ...To me, that sounds like a story full of dreams.
...To me, it sounds like a story full of "dreams."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu... Hahaha...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Then let us make it come true together.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Upon a dreamlike journey—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Those words from Dream Journey sounded like the most powerful declaration she had ever made."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sky the traveler gazes up at is clear and serene.
Just like the eye of a storm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her gaze was fixed firmly on————the Takarazuka Kinen.
